commit.message:
Recognize HLSL .fx effect techniques and shader semantics (#8184)

* Recognize HLSL effect techniques and shader semantics

Add a positive .fx heuristic for HLSL techniques and typed shader semantics, leaving FLUX and inconclusive content to existing detection. Reuse HLSL/FLUX samples and cover modern signals independently.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Use ordinary HLSL fixtures for effect heuristic tests

Move the unchanged .fx regression fixtures out of Generic because .fx is not a generic extension. Discover both through the existing all_fixtures helper without a special directory glob.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Recognize FLUX source declarations in .fx files

Add a positive FLUX source-declaration heuristic with identifier characters taken from FLUX's shared lexer token. Update the existing .fx sample test to expect FLUX directly while preserving the HLSL rules and inconclusive fallback behavior.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Link FLUX identifier heuristic to its lexer

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
